k_b_ads = 0.82999999999999996
k_a_des = 0.64000000000000001
k_b_des = 0.51000000000000001
k_eley_rideal = 0.23999999999999999
k_langmuir_hinshelwood = 1.6000000000000001
initial_empty_population = 1
a_state_exit = laplace_rate + k_a_des + k_b_ads * b_concentration
b_state_exit = laplace_rate + k_b_des + (k_a_ads + k_eley_rideal) * a_concentration
ab_state_exit = laplace_rate + k_a_des + k_b_des + k_langmuir_hinshelwood
ab_laplace_per_empty = (k_b_ads * b_concentration * k_a_ads * a_concentration / a_state_exit + k_a_ads * a_concentration * k_b_ads * b_concentration / b_state_exit) / (ab_state_exit - k_b_ads * b_concentration * k_b_des / a_state_exit - k_a_ads * a_concentration * k_a_des / b_state_exit)
a_laplace_per_empty = (k_a_ads * a_concentration + k_b_des * ab_laplace_per_empty) / a_state_exit
b_laplace_per_empty = (k_b_ads * b_concentration + k_a_des * ab_laplace_per_empty) / b_state_exit
empty_laplace_population = initial_empty_population / (laplace_rate + k_a_ads * a_concentration + k_b_ads * b_concentration - k_a_des * a_laplace_per_empty - (k_b_des + k_eley_rideal * a_concentration) * b_laplace_per_empty - k_langmuir_hinshelwood * ab_laplace_per_empty)
a_laplace_population = a_laplace_per_empty * empty_laplace_population
b_laplace_population = b_laplace_per_empty * empty_laplace_population
ab_laplace_population = ab_laplace_per_empty * empty_laplace_population
eley_rideal_product_laplace_rate = k_eley_rideal * a_concentration * b_laplace_population
langmuir_hinshelwood_product_laplace_rate = k_langmuir_hinshelwood * ab_laplace_population
response = laplace_rate * (eley_rideal_product_laplace_rate + langmuir_hinshelwood_product_laplace_rate)
